question: Parent and grandparent sponsorship: confirm the sponsor was invited to apply and the intake is open
help: New applications have been paused since 2026-01-01 (MI89; knowledge base parents-grandparents.md, checked 2026-11-07). Check policy-tracker before relying on this form

question: Is your spouse or common-law partner co-signing the undertaking? If yes: name and date of birth
help: A co-signer's income can be combined with yours

question: Number of persons in box 3 of the Generic Application Form (IMM 0008) for this undertaking
Persons in previous undertakings you signed or co-signed, still in effect or not yet in effect (i to iv)
help: Check every previous undertaking for default (IRPR s.133(1)(g))

question: If your spouse or partner is co-signing: persons in their previous undertakings (i to iv)
Your spouse or common-law partner, if not already included
Every other family member not included above and dependent on you financially
Total number of persons for determining the minimum necessary income (family size)
help: Family size is counted for each tax year; count each person in the year they joined the family

question: Names and dates of birth of everyone counted above: previous undertakings, your spouse or partner, other dependants
help: Must add up to the family size

question: Sponsor: do you consent to IRCC collecting your SIN to ask CRA for your income tax information for the three tax years before applying?
Co-signer: do you consent to IRCC collecting your SIN to ask CRA for your income tax information for the same three tax years?
Your current situation: unemployed, employed or self-employed
Employment history and periods of unemployment for the last three consecutive tax years: dates, employer, address, phone, gross income, family size
Your co-signing spouse or partner: current situation and employment history for the same three tax years
Income for each of the three tax years before applying (Notice of Assessment line 15000, with the co-signer's added) against the minimum necessary income plus 30%
help: IRPR s.133(1)(j)(i)(B). The table in templates/form-specs/income-tables.csv is IRCC's table for the 2025 intake (tax years 2022 to 2024). Check IRCC's current table for any later intake. Quebec has its own test

question: Signatures of the sponsor and any co-signer, and dates
help: Only the sponsor and co-signer can sign
